test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 27 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Three men and two women can finish a work in 120 over13 days. Two men and three women can finish the same in 10 days. One man and one woman start the work and after 12 days, 1 more man joins the work. After three more days, it is directed to engage more men or women to finish the work the next day. How many minimum more men or women must be engaged to complete the work as per direction?
solution:
**Given Data:**

3 men and 2 women can finish a job in 120/13 days

2 men and 3 women can finish the same job in 10 days

**Concept:**

We need to solve these equations to find the time one man and one woman can finish the job.

**Solution:**

Work done in both case is equal, so

⇒ (3M + 2W) × 120/13 = (2M + 3W) × 10

Solving these equations, we get:

⇒ M : W = 3 : 2

Total work = (3 × 3 + 2 × 2) × 120/13 = 120 units

One man and one woman start working and after 12 days, one more man joins the work. So:

⇒ (3 + 2) × 12 = 60 units

Remaining work = 120 - 60 = 60 units

1 more man joins the work. So after three more days work completed = (2 × 3 + 2) × 3 = 24 units

Remaining work = 60 - 24 = 36 units

To engage more men or women to finish the work the next day,

(2 + X) × 3 + (1 + Y) × 2 = 36

⇒ 6 + 3X + 2 + 2Y = 36

⇒ 3X + 2Y = 28

If all men are joining then put Y = 0

⇒ 3X = 28

⇒ X = 9.33 or approx 10 men

If all women are joining then put X = 0

⇒ 2Y = 28

⇒ Y = 14 women

**Therefore, to finish the work as per direction, a minimum of either 14 women or 10 men must be engaged.**
